qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Outsourced category management, consolidated single-truck delivery for non-food consumables, and expanding private-label penetration (~25%+ of sales) insulate Bunzl from disintermediation and expanded structural operating margins to 7.7-8.3% across cycles.
qualitative.note: Defensive consumables compounder with multi-decade compounding record. Consolidated store-level delivery of essential non-food consumables yields 20%+ ROIC and >100% FCF conversion, with self-funded bolt-on acquisitions compounding per-share intrinsic value. [5-10Y g: organic volume/price 1.5% + self-funded bolt-on M&A 3.5% + buybacks 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC consistently 17-22% (median 20.6%), with operating ROIC >100%. Free cash flow conversion averages >100% (FY25 Owner FCF £838M vs NI £459M). 31+ consecutive years of dividend increases. Leverage at 2.0x net debt/EBITDA (£1.2B net debt repayable in ~1.4 years of Owner FCF), comfortably weathering the temporary 2025 US foodservice margin dip.
